name: Kurita Tooru
source:
3rd year high school student.
Likes: Cute Things
Dislikes: Scary Things

The protagonist's childhood friend and classmate.
He's a helpful, stable, reliable person. Also a great sportsman.
He gets good grades too and is quite popular at school, but he doesn't really care too much about that himself.
